name: Can I remove a popcorn ceiling myself or should I hire a professional?

mainEntity.name: Can I remove a popcorn ceiling myself or should I hire a professional?

acceptedAnswer.text: While DIY popcorn ceiling removal is possible, it is often a labor-intensive and messy job that can lead to unexpected complications like drywall damage or the discovery of asbestos. Hiring a professional contractor ensures the job is done efficiently, safely, and with proper waste disposal. Professionals also have the tools and experience to achieve a smooth, high-quality finish, saving you time and potential headaches.
acceptedAnswer.description: Hiring a professional for popcorn ceiling removal is recommended due to the mess, labor, potential for asbestos, and skill required for a quality finish.
